region.name: Glasswind Shelf
region.description: The bell above the slate switchbacks rings before each gust.

locations.name: Kitehook Station
locations.description: Leeward cable station overlooks Cliff switchback. Anwen’s pennants hang slack on one side of the lift. Secure the lee-side cable before launch.

locations.name: Windpost Trial
locations.description: Sheltered launch · Steer through six numbered rings. Hold the line through gusts and ease it before tension peaks. Cliff strikes restart at your last ring and add five seconds.
